title: Cinematic Product Launch
sourcePrompt: Create a 20-second cinematic launch film for a fictional premium wireless audio product. Make it tactile, restrained and memorable, without inventing product specs.
objective: Build desire by revealing the product's tactile design and presence rather than listing features.
audience: Design-conscious consumers who respond to premium product craft.
desiredResponse: Remember the product silhouette and associate it with thoughtful craftsmanship.
creativeThesis: Reveal the product through material, sound and controlled movement; each shot uncovers one layer of identity until a confident hero frame.

visualLanguage.typography: Editorial sans-serif; short all-caps copy only when needed.
visualLanguage.composition: Asymmetric macro crops evolving into a balanced hero composition.
visualLanguage.lighting: Soft directional key with narrow edge highlights and rich but readable shadows.
visualLanguage.texture: Brushed metal, satin polymer and subtle grain.

storytellingStrategy: Open on a concealed material detail; progressively reveal silhouette, one meaningful construction detail and then the complete product. Use visual progression rather than feature cards.
motionLanguage: Slow macro push, one lateral move, a restrained orbit and deliberate settling motion. Each move is motivated by a reveal.
soundIdentity: Minimal electronic pulse with tactile foley, quiet transitions and a clean final tail. No generic whooshes.
productionMethodStrategy: Use a custom 3D product scene for macro and hero shots; use typography only to punctuate the reveal. Product is fictional and can be modeled with simple geometry. Avoid unsupported generative-video assumptions.
constraints: No fabricated specifications, endorsements or testimonials.
Use original assets or assets with verified reuse rights.
Keep copy short and within title-safe areas.
assumptions: The product is fictional and no reference images are supplied.
acceptanceCriteria: The silhouette is fully revealed by the midpoint.
At least three visibly distinct shot scales or compositions are used.
Every shot has a visible action or material change.
The final hero shot resolves the opening visual motif.
